caption: The drawing features a wooden armchair with red upholstery on both the seat and the backrest. The frame of the chair, including the arms and legs, appears to be made of a brown wood with detailed carving, particularly noticeable on the legs which have a curving, cabriole shape. The backrest has a tall, rectangular shape with a rounded, scalloped top edge and is outlined with a wooden border. The arms of the chair are slightly curved outward. In the upper left corner of the image, there is an inset drawing depicting a single elaborately carved chair leg, shown from a side perspective. This leg is gray in color with additional decorative detailing and ends in a scroll at the bottom. Both the main chair and the inset are outlined with thin, dark lines, and the background is an off-white or light beige color.
title: Armchair
